notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased jump height
[*] Slightly decreased spring boost height
[*] Adjusted balloon gravity curve
[*] Adjusted layout of some rooms to accommodate new jump heights
[*] Extended delay between enemy beam charge and fire in some rooms
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] When choosing a piece or relic reward, navigation can now wrap around from last option to first, and vice-versa
[*] Fixed piece / relic card instances of tooltips appearing off-screen and double tooltips
[*] Fixed issue where some piece / relic previews were unable to be dismissed by clicking outside of them
[*] Fixed various typos
[/list]

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the second tutorial room, pieces no longer fall during the initial dialogue
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where some wall-jumps would send the player straight up instead of away from the wall
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed relic "Hope" rarity from epic to legendary
[*] Fixed "Up, Up, and Away" achievement counting some wall-jumps towards unlock progress
[*] Changed relics "Manna Chime" and "Frigid Amulet" to only trigger in climb and boss rooms
[*] Removed echoing from Spring and Superspring blocks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Patch[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed misaligned layout of one of the climb rooms
[*] Fixed damage-activated relics incorrectly triggering in non-climb rooms
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.0 - Run Customization and More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! While there has been many smaller updates to the Tower of Nod demo so far, this one is worth calling extra attention to.

Most notably, v0.2.0 introduces [b]Run Customization[/b]! This allows you to experiment with Tower of Nod however you'd like by choosing your starting character's Relics and Piece Library. You can use this to lower or increase the run's difficulty, test out interesting synergies, or discover new effects!

Also included in Run Customization is the ability to set the run's seed for consistent level generation and RNG. Seeds for runs can now be viewed on the pause screen.

I hope you've been enjoying the demo so far, and excited for more updates to come!

See you soon,
